newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 600 MW Homer City coal unit now seen up Friday.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 600 MW Homer City coal unit now seen up Friday.

text.p: Restart of the 600 megawatt (MW) unit at the Homer City, Pa., coal-fired generating station was pushed back to Friday due to a problem with an electrical line, the operator said.
"It's expected back early tomorrow," said a spokeswoman for GPU Generation Inc.
Homer City's unit 2 was shut Monday to repair an oil feed pump, and was earlier expected to resume service today.
Pennsylvania Electric Co (Penelec) and New York Electric & Gas Corp, each have 50 percent stake in Homer City 2.
Both Penelec and GPU Generation are subsidiaries of GPU Inc of Parsippany, N.J.
